exposure: Diabetes in pregnancy (pregestational or gestational diabetes mellitus)
outcome: Fetal and neonatal cardiac geometry and function
cohort: The study included 75 pregnant women delivering at term, comprising 54 normal pregnancies and 21 with a diagnosis of pregestational or gestational diabetes mellitus, and their fetuses/neonates.
finding: Compared with normal term fetuses and neonates, those of diabetic women exhibited cardiac indices indicative of myocardial impairment, with some improvements observed in cardiac indices after delivery in the diabetes group.
